en-US/en-GB.decision: Retain existing English family default and canonical source spelling. Meaning and functional arguments are compatible; no claim of region-specific native style.

es-ES/es-LA.decision: Neutral Spanish wording preserves the same feature contracts. Videos/vídeos and app-setting vocabulary are intelligible regional choices; no new broad-region alias is introduced. es-LA is the native code; es-419 is its semantic region, not a Java alias.

fr-FR/fr-CA.decision: Shared French app register (tu) and explicit functional nouns avoid region-specific legal/currency assumptions. Preserve the existing fr family default; community regional style review remains open.

pt-PT/pt-BR.decision: Keep separate exact variants; pt-PT remains the intentional pt default.

zh-CN/zh-HK/zh-TW.decision: Separate exact regional packs; no broad zh default, and no claim that mechanical script conversion is sufficient.

system-identities.decision: Chinese script tags and Serbian Cyrillic carry identical reviewed text from their corresponding region/script. Native tl-PH is labelled Filipino; CLDR48 maps legacy tl to fil. Strict modern fil-PH needs its own pack identity; fil family default points there. No extra translated language is counted.
